items.title: How much does spreading knowledge actually shorten an incident?
items.description: The payments-retry incident took about 160 minutes because only 1 of the 6 on-call rotation members (Priya) had real context on the retry queue — whoever else got paged had to diagnose from scratch (about 180 minutes) instead of applying the known fix (about 4 minutes). Drag the slider to see the expected resolution time as more people on the rotation actually have working context, assuming the person paged is chosen at random from the rotation.

params.name: peopleWithContext
params.label: People on the rotation with real context

items.compute: const rotationSize = 6; const fastFixMinutes = 4; const fromScratchMinutes = 180; const probabilityKnowledgeable = params.peopleWithContext / rotationSize; const expectedMinutes = Math.round(probabilityKnowledgeable * fastFixMinutes + (1 - probabilityKnowledgeable) * fromScratchMinutes); return { expectedMinutes };
